gold_comments.issue_summary: I wonder if it’s possible to broadcast after calling LMCache’s kernel to transfer `memory_obj` from CPU to GPU, instead of using `tensor.to`, since it’s faster.
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The comment must cite the added `save_only_first_rank` logic (lines 100–105) and the unchanged use of `tensor.to` in the broadcast path (line 537) as evidence that the performance concern about broadcast timing was not addressed.
gold_comments.rationale: A human reviewer would raise this because the diff introduces rank-0-only saving but retains the potentially suboptimal `tensor.to` call before broadcasting, missing an opportunity to leverage faster LMCache kernel transfers first.
gold_comments._reviewer_comment_full: I wonder if it’s possible to broadcast after calling LMCache’s kernel to transfer `memory_obj` from CPU to GPU, instead of using `tensor.to`, since it’s faster.
